tests.goal: Confirm that the Getting Started tour can be completed with no missed steps

steps.action: Click the MyAssist Academy button and launch the Getting Started tour.
Click through every step, checking the numbers increase sequentially.
Rate the tour at the end and provide feedback.
acceptanceCriteria: The rating and feedback are accepted with a toast notification

tests.goal: Confirm that MyAssist Academy contains Release Notes and Common Questions tabs

steps.action: Open the Learn menu > MyAssist Academy.
acceptanceCriteria: The Release Notes tab shows Release 7.1.0 and 7.1.1 and the text reads correctly

tests.goal: Confirm that guided-tour progress is stored per user, however the tour was started, and resumes in another browser

steps.action: In MyAssist Academy, start the Getting Started tour (from the Learn menu or the All Resources tab), advance a few steps and close it part-way.
Refresh, or log in from another browser or incognito window.
acceptanceCriteria: The tour shows "in progress" with a percentage

steps.action: Navigate back into MyAssist Academy and continue the Getting Started tour.
acceptanceCriteria: The tour resumes at the same step

tests.goal: Confirm that the Learn menu contains the Learning Centre items

acceptanceCriteria: "Take a guided tutorial" and "Give feedback" are shown
"Ask MyAssist FAQ agent" appears if the FAQ agent exists and opens it
